title: Unique factorization results for generalized power series
summary: Factorization in rings of the form $K((G^{\le 0} )) $ exhibits pathological behavior due to divisibility by monomials. It remains open whether this is the only obstruction and whether the quotient by the ideal generated by all monomials is a unique factorization domain. Prior to this work, the only instances of unique factorization beyond the irreducible elements followed directly from the primality of elements which aren't divisible by any monomial and whose support has order type $ω$ or $ω+1$.
